_help: Green Button Connect (Share My Data) public configuration. Fill this in AFTER Con Edison third-party onboarding issues a client id and publishes the authorize/Data-Custodian endpoints — until then the site ships with configured:false and the connect panel never appears. Only PUBLIC values belong here: the client secret never touches this file (it is a Cloudflare Pages env binding on the /api/gbc/token function; see docs/notes/gbc-data-boundary.md). Path templates default to the ESPI 1.1 resource shapes in public/gbc.js and are overridden here only if ConEd's Data Custodian deviates from them.
